append.detail: suppress() in lib/suppression.ts wrapped its pre-check and insert in a blanket try/catch with an empty catch and never read the supabase { error } that supabase-js resolves with instead of rejecting, and recordEmailEvent() awaited its insert without reading error either. So a bounce or complaint whose suppression or email_events append failed during a database blip could never reject, the Resend webhook never released its svix claim or returned 503, Resend never redelivered, and the address kept getting mail; the unsubscribe action likewise told a member they were unsubscribed when no row landed. Fixed by removing the blanket catch: suppress() throws when the pre-check read carries an error, captures { error } from the insert, returns on code 23505 (a concurrent insert means the row exists, so it stays idempotent) and otherwise throws new Error(error.message); recordEmailEvent() captures { error } and throws on it. Every caller (resend webhook, unsubscribe action, recordGlobalStop, handleSpaceSendWebhook) already wraps the call in try/catch. Pinned in lib/suppression.test.ts: an insert resolving with code XX000 rejects, code 23505 resolves, a failed pre-check read rejects without inserting, and recordEmailEvent rejects on an insert error.
